newsitem.title: UK: UK insurance association elects new chairman.
newsitem.headline: UK insurance association elects new chairman.

text.p: The Association of British Insurers (ABI) said on Tuesday its board had elected Roger Taylor as chairman for two years beginning July 1 1997.
The election of Taylor who is executive deputy chairman and chairman of the management board of Royal Sun Alliance, is subject to confirmation by members of the ABI at their annual meeting in July.

The ABI also said that Sandy Leitch, chief executive of B.A.T Industries subsidiary British American Financial Services Ltd, would succeed David Prosser as deputy chairman and would become chairman of the ABI's Life Insurance Council.
Albert Mills, group director of UK General Insurance and Direct Operations at Norwich Union will succeed Andrew Young as the ABI's other deputy chairman.
He will also become chairman of the ABI's General Insurance Council.
